biggest_catch: The friend must do real banking activity - 10 debit card transactions of $10+ AND two direct deposits of $500+ within 90 days - and if you share your link by text/social you must include the required disclosure sentence or both of you get disqualified.
catches: Referrer earns a $100 Reward per qualifying referral for checking accounts opened on/after 3/1/2026 ($50 for accounts opened before 3/1/2026); cap of $500 per calendar year.
Friend must register via the referral link, open a qualifying checking account within 90 days of registering, and not have been a primary checking owner at First Financial in the past 12 months.

Consumer checking: 10 debit transactions of $10+ (non-ATM) AND two direct deposits of $500+ within 90 days. Business checking: 10 payment transactions of $25+ AND $2,000 in total deposits within 90 days.
Rewards paid as virtual Visa Reward Cards ~3 weeks after completion; cards expire 6 months after issuance.
IRS tax reporting applies; employees of First Financial Bank and household members are ineligible.
First referral registration wins if multiple people refer the same individual; no partial rewards (e.g. $450 + one more referral pays nothing extra).

steps: Register for the First Financial Bank refer-a-friend program and share your unique link (include the required disclosure if sharing by text/social).
Friend registers via your link and opens a qualifying checking account within 90 days.
Friend completes the qualifying activities within 90 days (consumer: 10 debits of $10+ and two $500 direct deposits; business: 10 payments of $25+ and $2,000 in deposits).
You receive a $100 virtual Visa Reward Card ~3 weeks later (up to $500/year).
timing: Virtual Visa Reward Card delivered ~3 weeks after all qualifying activities complete (friend has 90 days from account opening); card expires 6 months after issuance.
when_cash_arrives: Per official terms: Virtual Visa Reward Card delivered ~3 weeks after all qualifying activities complete (friend has 90 days from account opening); card expires 6 months after issuance. — structural: a 90-day account-open/seasoning requirement must elapse before payout.
maximize: Front-load the friend's qualifying activity: terms give the friend a multi-week window, but the payout clock starts at completion — a friend who finishes in week 1 gets you paid weeks earlier.
The 90-day seasoning/hold is structural — pick a different referral program if you need money sooner.
Volume constraint noted in terms: cap of $500 per calendar year — plan referral count against the cap, not the calendar.
